verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers general transaction sync, nexus determination, registrations, and filings, but nothing addresses marketplace-facilitator-collected transactions specifically (e.g., a flag or field to mark facilitator-collected sales so they count toward nexus without being double-remitted). This is a standard, well-known sales-tax compliance concern (marketplace facilitator laws) that a product like Kintsugi could plausibly support, but no documentation mentions it.
